meta.title: Ondra Grow
meta.description: Growth for Ondra (L9 extension pool): four existing readings (days together, interaction count, active memory count, relationship stage order) are normalised and weighted into one mileage score, mapped onto five levels (sprout / bud / leaf / bloom / fruit), with a single next-step hint that contains no numbers. Read-only derivation: no second set of numbers, no score read-out, no relationship writes, no UI.
